system.description: You gain advantage on melee attacks made with an ally within 5ft of your target who is not incapacitated. Furthermore, when flanking an enemy with an ally, raise the expertise die for your action from 1d4 to a 1d6. Finally, if you make the first attack in a surprise round, that attack’s critical threshold lowers to 19. If you already have a feature that increases the range of your critical hits, your critical hit range increases by 1 (maximum 17–20).
system.prerequisite: must have taken Raider Initiate previously, must have proficiency in at least one weapon type other than simple
